dev_notes: releaseDiff() in src/diff.mjs is the packet the readout, `diff --full`/`--json`, the compose brief and verify all read. Code churn is `git diff --numstat <previous release commit>` against the working tree plus untracked files, mapped through ownership. The last look is .ledger/.cache/last-look.json (gitignored), written by `ledger preview`; it fingerprints each entry's own words and counts its events, so composing doesn't read as a change.

history.name: The size of the open release
history.description: The command ledger preview opens with how big the open release is: its new, updated and removed entries by size, how many changes were recorded and how many of them ledger prepare hasn't read yet, and how many lines of code changed since the last edition's commit. It needs nothing but the ledger and git, so it costs nothing to run.
